item.title: DAG consensus, decided on evidence
item.body:
Keep the whitepaper's goal of sub-second commits with parallel proposers, and build it
only if the evidence says the finality gadget is not enough (roadmap M9).

- Build if sustained load passes about 50 account blocks per momentum for a quarter
- If built: a Mahi-Mahi or Mysticeti variant over Pillar weights, model-checked
- Months of shadow mode before rewards migrate
item.author: dev-ada
